subject: The Water Temple
text: At the top level on the north side of the tower, using the Longshot on the dragon's head pulls Link up to go through the door behind the statue.

evidence.quote:
Head to the top level of the room, and go to the north side of the tower.  Use
the Longshot on the dragon's head to pull yourself up, and go through the door
behind the statue.

subject: Blade Trap Room
text: In the Blade Trap Room, climb the steep hill past three Blade Traps using the Kokiri Boots to reach the Boss Door.

evidence.quote:
This room contains a steep hill with three slow moving Blade Traps that strafe
slowly back and forth.  To get up the hill, you have to start climbing it using
the Kokiri Boots, and keep pressing forward....Once at the top of the ramp, enter the Boss Door.

subject: Morpha
text: During the Morpha boss fight, avoid entering the water and avoid standing on the four inner platforms to prevent Morpha from grabbing you with its arms.

evidence.quote:
For the duration of this boss fight, it's very important that you avoid
entering the water, since this will give the boss easy opportunity to attack
you.  You should also avoid standing on the four platforms on the inside of the
room, since this will allow Morpha to attack you from several sides

subject: Morpha
text: When Morpha's nucleus enters an arm, grab it with the Longshot and attack it with a Jump Attack using the Biggoron's Sword or Megaton Hammer.

evidence.quote:
When Morpha enters one of it's arms, this is your opportunity to attack.  Grab
it with the Longshot, and it will remained stunned long enough for you to
attack it once, maybe twice.  Which is why you should make that attack a Jump
Attack with the Biggoron Sword...If you don't have the Biggoron's Sword, then a Jump Attack with the
Megaton Hammer will do.

subject: Heart Container
text: After defeating Morpha, collect the Heart Container left behind in the dried up pool.

evidence.quote: Take the Heart Container it leaves behind in the now-dried up pool, then enter the beam of light to meet the Sage of Water: Ruto.

subject: Ruto
text: Ruto grants Link the Medallion of Water after entering the beam of light.

evidence.quote:
enter the beam of light to meet the Sage of Water: Ruto.  Ruto will give
you the Medallion of Water, and cancels your marriage plans

subject: Lake Hylia
text: After completing the Water Temple, Lake Hylia fills back up with water.

evidence.quote: Lake Hylia will now fill back up with water.

subject: Fire Arrow
text: Shoot an arrow directly into the sun at sunrise from the island plaque in Lake Hylia to make the Fire Arrows appear on the smaller island.

evidence.quote:
Run to the east side of the island, where you will find a plaque set into the
ground...So fire an arrow
directly into the sun, and the Fire Arrows will fall from the sky onto the
smaller island east of the larger one.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At nighttime atop the dead tree on Lake Hylia's main island, defeat the Gold Skulltula with the Longshot to obtain its token.

evidence.quote:
Return to the larger island, and use the
Longshot to pull yourself up to the top of the dead tree...Once you're at the top of the tree, make it nighttime to make a
Gold Skulltula appear on the top of the trunk.  Don't try to jump up and kill
it; just stand on the branch and use the Longshot.

subject: Temple of Time
text: Play the Prelude of Light to return to the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote:
Once you have the Token, play the Prelude of Light to return to the Temple of
Time.

subject: Sheik
text: Sheik teaches Link the Nocturne of Shadow upon entering Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Afterwards, Sheik will teach you the Nocturne of
Shadow.  This transportation song is the ONLY way to reach the Shadow Temple.

subject: Dampe's Grave
text: Pull Dampe's grave backward in Kakariko Graveyard to reveal a pit leading to Dampe's Amazing Cave Race Game.

evidence.quote:
Head for Dampe's Grave (it's the only gravestone with flowers on the left
aisle).  Pull it backwards to reveal a pit, and drop back down to Dampe's
Amazing Cave Race Game.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: Finishing Dampe's race in under 1:00 by rolling and using the Longshot in the final room rewards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
you probably didn't win the Piece of Heart you get for finishing the race in under
1:00.  To accomplish this, you're going to have to follow the exact route you
followed before, only you'll have to roll the whole way (which is slightly
faster).  The other difference is, when you reach the last room (the large room
with the spiral ramp that rises up), use the Longshot from the bottom of the
room to pull yourself up to the door.

subject: Dampe's Amazing Cave Race Game
text: During Dampe's race, run forward dodging flames, turn right, turn left wide, pass between flames, turn left then right wide, turn right, left, left tight, right tight through the door, right, right, wide left, enter wide room through right door, left, wide right through door, right, tight left, ledge left wall, wide left, tight left into tall room, and Longshot to a torch near the top under one minute.

evidence.quote:
Immediately run forward, dodging the
flames that Dampe drops (he'll drop them the entire race - keep an eye out for
them).  Turn right at the halls end, taking the corner tight to dodge a flame.
Turn left at the next corner, taking the turn wide to dodge another flame.

Run forward between the pair of flames, running along the left side of the gap.
Turn left and then right immediately on the other side, taking the turn wide to
dodge another flame.  Turn right, then left, then left again, taking the turn
tight.  Take another tight turn on the other side, and go through the door.

Take a right on the other side, and another right, and then a wide left.  Run
along the left or right side of the tunnel, then enter the wide room.  Go
through the door on the right.  Take a left, then a wide right, then through
another door.  Run to the wall on the other side, then a right, then a tight
left.

Jump onto the ledge to your left, and hug the left wall as you run forward to
dodge more flames.  Take a wide left, then a tight left to enter a tall room
with a large pit in the middle.  Use the Longshot to latch onto one of the
torches near the top of the room, and pull yourself up.  If you make it under
one minute, then Dampe will give you a Piece of Heart for your efforts.

subject: Windmill
text: Going through the door past Dampe's race room and climbing the stairs leads back into the Windmill.

evidence.quote:
Go through the door on the other side of the room, climb up the stairs and
you'll find yourself back in the Windmill.

subject: Musical Frogs
text: Playing all basic songs for the Musical Frogs in Zora's River and finishing their minigame rewards two Pieces of Heart.

evidence.quote:
If you still haven't played all of the basic songs for the Musical Frogs in Zora's
River, and finished their minigame, then do so now.  The two Pieces of Heart
earned are more then worth it.

subject: Kakariko Graveyard
text: After warping with the Nocturne of Shadow as Young Link, run west and jump over the fence to return to the lower Graveyard and Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Young Link can't do much in or around the Shadow Temple, so run west as you
warp in and jump over the fence to return to the lower area of the Graveyard,
then run out to the Village.

subject: Windmill
text: Playing the Song of Storms for the Organ Grinder in the Windmill as Young Link drains the well outside.

evidence.quote:
Go into the Windmill and play the Organ Grinder the Song of Storms, and the
well outside will drain.  If it doesn't work, it's because you're still Adult
Link, numb skull.

subject: Bottom of the Well
text: Dropping into the drained well reveals a passage at the bottom leading to the Bottom of the Well mini-dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Once the well is drained, go outside and drop to it's
bottom.  You'll find a passage at the bottom.  Go through it.
